segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Kevin at Northstar Foods. Yeah, so we need to add 12 seats to our account before our training on August 12th.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I confirm the account is Northstar Foods, account ID 48219, on the Standard annual plan?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's right. We have 48 seats today and want to go to 60.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m in the billing tool now. The prorated amount for the 12 additional seats through your renewal on February 28th is $1,836.00 before tax. Is it okay to apply that to the card ending in 4412?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's fine. And can you make them available right away?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I’ve added the seats and refreshed the admin console. You should now see 12 available seats under Users.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let me check. Yeah, I see 12 available. Perfect.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I also emailed the receipt to billing@northstarfoods.com and opened ticket 318742 for the change record. Anything else I can help with?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's all. Thanks for the quick help.
